title: 9k-dataset
summary: A machine-learning experimentation repository that trains XGBoost classifiers on tabular datasets of varying sizes (1k/3k/9k), using synthetic data augmentation to address class imbalance. It directly imports and runs the standalone CTGAN package to generate synthetic training rows for these experiments.
